# Pikvaa

> Pikvaa is a studio app for Indian photographers: client photo selection by the whole family in private PIN galleries, payment-linked online delivery, leads/quotes/bookings/crew CRM, and per-event storage packs priced in rupees. Tamil and English. Built for low-end Android phones and slow networks.

Key facts (prices before 18% GST): Lite 3 GB ₹99/6 months, ₹149/12 months; Wedding 40 GB ₹999/6 months (about ₹1,179 incl. GST); 50 GB ₹1,249; 120 GB ₹2,999/6 months. Free plan available; Pro priced at ₹4,999/year + GST (being confirmed with photography studios). Clients pay studios directly; Pikvaa records payments and releases finals when paid. No AI face search, no print store, no unlimited storage; Pikvaa does not back up originals.

## Product

- [Features - Photo Selection, Delivery & Studio CRM | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/features/): Explore Pikvaa features: client photo selection, online gallery delivery, studio management CRM for bookings, crew and payments, and per-event storage.
- [Wedding Photo Selection App for Photographers | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/features/photo-selection/): Pikvaa's photo selection software lets the whole family pick album photos live in a private, watermarked PIN gallery. No app install. Built for India.
- [Online Photo Delivery & Client Galleries | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/features/photo-delivery/): Deliver photos to clients through private PIN galleries on WhatsApp. Pikvaa releases full-quality downloads only when payments are recorded. Priced in ₹.
- [Photography Studio Management Software & CRM India | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/features/studio-management/): Run leads, OTP-accepted quotes, bookings, crew, freelancers and payment records in one photography CRM built for Indian studios. Tamil and English.
- [Photo Storage for Photographers, Per Event | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/features/storage-protection/): Per-event photo storage for photographers in India: 3 GB to 120 GB packs, locked expiry dates, a 30-day archive and optional verified backup of finals.

## Pricing

- [Pikvaa Pricing - Per-Event Packs from ₹99 + GST](https://pikvaa.com/pricing/): Pikvaa pricing in rupees: Lite 3 GB ₹99, Wedding 40 GB ₹999, 120 GB ₹2,999 for 6 months, before 18% GST. GST-inclusive totals shown. Free plan available.

## Solutions

- [App for Wedding Photographers in India | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/solutions/wedding-photographers/): Pikvaa helps Indian wedding photographers run album selection with the whole family, record part-payments and deliver finals securely. From ₹999 + GST per wedding.
- [Software for Photography Studios in India | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/solutions/studios/): Studio software for Indian photography studios: leads, quotes, bookings, staff roles, freelancers, payments and client delivery. Pro priced at ₹4,999/year + GST.
- [App for Freelance Photographers in India | Pikvaa](https://pikvaa.com/solutions/freelancers/): Pikvaa helps freelance photographers deliver client galleries professionally and join studio shoots per event, free, without seeing the studio's business data.
